title: 2024 TTX · counterair sweep
subtitle: Expendable CCA axes, fighter follow-on, between-pulse pressure
description: Mitchell Institute 2024 tabletop-exercise counterair sweep team: three axes of expendable counterair and EW CCA stimulate air defenses ahead of maritime strike pulses; F-22/F-35 follow-on and recoverable CCA-1 with F-15EX sustain pressure between pulses.
assumptions: Source-grounded mission roles and three-axis concept from pp. 17-18, Figures 3-5. The three axis lines on this map are conceptual and DO NOT reproduce tabletop team flight coordinates, tactical geometry, or exact force counts.
The published team's 3:1 air-to-air weapon versus EW CCA mix is a reported planning ratio, not a direct count of displayed icons.
All path positions, offsets, headings and timeline seconds are editorial visualization, NOT exercise tracks, real airbase locations, performance, engagement geometry, or elapsed mission time.
Illustration renders one symbol per selected mission role, not the number of aircraft planned. The source's 3:1 air-to-air to electronic-warfare ratio is not represented by icon count.
Expendable CCA icons use conceptual outbound paths only, not recovery legs; any final stationary display is a visualization artifact, not evidence of survival or loitering.

phases.title: Notional Maritime Strike Context
phases.narrative: Introduce three notional expendable CCA approach axes described in Figure 4; displayed locations are fictional.

phases.title: Three Expendable CCA Axes
phases.narrative: Expendable CCA carrying air-to-air and EW payload concepts stimulate PLA air defense reactions on three illustrated axes (Figure 4).

phases.title: Defense Reactions / Cues
phases.narrative: The team sought to expose reactions and complicate defense decisions; the map does not simulate sensor detection or weapons.

phases.title: F-22 / F-35 Follow-On
phases.narrative: The TTX sweep concept follows one of the axes with F-22 and F-35 fighters and air-to-air CCA (Figure 4).

phases.title: Maritime Strike-Pulse Support
phases.narrative: The baseline exercise assumes two maritime strike pulses per day; Figure 3's force numbers are not individual aircraft tracks.

phases.title: CCA-1 and F-15EX Pressure
phases.narrative: Recoverable fighter-like CCA-1 screens support standoff F-15EX and notional ISR or expendable counterair CCA between pulses (Figure 5).

phases.title: Conceptual Next Pulse
phases.narrative: An explanatory reset shows how the team varied approach-axis geometry between pulses; its path is fictional.
